description.text: Program Description:A Bachelor of Pharmacy (abbreviated B Pharm or BS Pharm) is an undergraduate academic degree in the field of pharmacy. The degree is the basic prerequisite for registration to practice as a pharmacist in many countries. It's training to understand the properties and impacts of medicines and developing the skills required to counsel patients about their use.Future Career:B Pharm holders can work in several fields such as being a pharmacist, patient counseling, doing further studies such as master degree, working in a university as a lecturer, or working as a drug information specialist.

duration.text: The Pharmacy at Dalian Medical University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3888 USD/per year ￥ 28000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of the passport( two continuous empty visa pages)The passport must have an expiry date after September of the year you apply, if the validity of the applicant's current passport does not meet the requirement, please apply for a new passport before submitting the application.2.Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3.Graduation certificate of high school(Both Chinese Version and English Version)4. Academic transcript of high school(Both Chinese Version and English Version)5.Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning)With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included.For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper.6. Photocopy of Physical Examination Record.Applicants should strictly check the items in accordance with the requirements of Physical Examination Record.pdf Incomplete records or those without the signature of the attending doctor, the official stamp of the hospital, or a sealed photograph of the applicants are invalid. The date shall be after October 1, 2023. The original piece is required during registration.7. family financial proof certificate (or one year bank statement)

requirements.text: The applicant should be above 18 years old, mental and physical healthy, has completed the senior high school course with good marks (above 60%), has solid financial support to afford the study and living expenses in China.
